description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for managing pricing rules within the ERPNext system, including fetching, filtering, sorting, and applying pricing rules, as well as handling coupon codes and free items.

classes.name: MultiplePricingRuleConflict
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling conflicts when multiple pricing rules apply.

methods.name: get_pricing_rules
methods.description: Fetches applicable pricing rules based on provided arguments and document context.

methods.name: sorted_by_priority
methods.description: Sorts a list of pricing rules by their priority, considering apply_multiple_pricing_rules flag.

methods.name: filter_pricing_rule_based_on_condition
methods.description: Filters pricing rules based on their condition evaluated against the document.

methods.name: _get_pricing_rules
methods.description: Retrieves pricing rules from the database based on apply_on criteria and arguments.

methods.name: apply_multiple_pricing_rules
methods.description: Checks if any pricing rule applies multiple pricing rules.

methods.name: _get_tree_conditions
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions for hierarchical item or warehouse groups.

methods.name: get_other_conditions
methods.description: Adds additional filtering conditions based on company, customer, supplier, campaign, and date.

methods.name: filter_pricing_rules
methods.description: Filters a list of pricing rules based on quantity, amount, and other criteria.

methods.name: validate_quantity_and_amount_for_suggestion
methods.description: Validates if quantities or amounts are within specified thresholds and provides user messages.

methods.name: filter_pricing_rules_for_qty_amount
methods.description: Filters pricing rules based on quantity and rate thresholds.

methods.name: if_all_rules_same
methods.description: Checks if all pricing rules have the same values for specified fields.

methods.name: apply_internal_priority
methods.description: Filters rules based on internal priority fields and arguments.

methods.name: get_qty_and_rate_for_mixed_conditions
methods.description: Calculates total quantity and amount considering mixed conditions and items.

methods.name: get_qty_and_rate_for_other_item
methods.description: Filters pricing rules based on other item quantities and amounts.

methods.name: get_qty_amount_data_for_cumulative
methods.description: Aggregates quantity and amount data over a date range for cumulative rules.

methods.name: apply_pricing_rule_on_transaction
methods.description: Applies pricing rules to a transaction document, including discounts and free items.

methods.name: remove_free_item
methods.description: Removes free items from a document's items list.

methods.name: get_applied_pricing_rules
methods.description: Parses and returns applied pricing rules from a string or list.

methods.name: get_product_discount_rule
methods.description: Generates free item data based on a pricing rule for discounts.

methods.name: apply_pricing_rule_for_free_items
methods.description: Adds free items to a document based on pricing rules.

methods.name: get_pricing_rule_items
methods.description: Retrieves item codes or groups applicable for a pricing rule.

methods.name: validate_coupon_code
methods.description: Validates coupon code validity based on date and usage limits.

methods.name: update_coupon_code_count
methods.description: Updates the usage count of a coupon code after a transaction.
